description: This file defines small_vector-like containers and utility classes for managing argument vectors efficiently, avoiding heap allocations, and managing PyObject references in the pybind11 library.

classes.name: inline_array_or_vector
classes.description: A union supporting small inline storage or heap-allocated std::vector, used for small vector optimization.

classes.name: small_vector
classes.description: A small vector implementation supporting inline storage for a fixed number of elements, with dynamic fallback.

classes.name: ref_small_vector
classes.description: A small vector of PyObject* that manages reference counting, holding references and releasing them on destruction.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the vector.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying data array.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the vector.

methods.name: emplace_back
methods.description: Constructs and adds an element to the end of the vector.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves capacity for at least the specified number of elements.

methods.name: push_back_steal
methods.description: Adds a PyObject* to the vector, taking ownership without incref.

methods.name: push_back_borrow
methods.description: Adds a PyObject* to the vector, incrementing ref count.

methods.name: push_back_null
methods.description: Adds a null pointer to the vector.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the boolean value at a specific index.

methods.name: is_inline
methods.description: Checks if the storage is inline or heap-allocated.
